listBalances.description: Returns an unpaginated current balance snapshot grouped by currency and balance source for the authenticated merchant.

listBalanceTransactions.description: Returns a paginated ledger of balance-affecting transactions, including availability timing and related public resources.

listCapabilities.description: Returns payment and money movement capability readiness for the authenticated merchant.

listCheckoutSessions.description: Returns a paginated list of checkout sessions for the authenticated merchant.

listCreditNoteAllocations.description: Returns every allocation made from a credit note, including reversed ones. Filter by idempotency_key to find the allocation a given request produced.

listCreditNoteRefunds.description: Lists linked refunds, including failed attempts, newest first. Filter by idempotency_key to recover a refund after a lost response.

listCreditNotes.description: Returns credit notes for the authenticated merchant, newest first. Filter by invoice_id to see everything credited against one invoice.

listCurrentAPIKeyRequestLogs.description: Returns request log summaries generated by the authenticated API key. Results are always scoped to the calling key. Full request and response bodies are intentionally omitted from this public API surface to reduce the risk of sensitive data leakage.

listCustomerAddresses.description: Lists the customer's saved addresses with billing and shipping default flags.

listCustomerDeletionRequests.description: Lists deletion requests across the selected merchant environment so a merchant can discover and review buyer-created requests.

listCustomers.description: Returns a paginated list of customers for the authenticated merchant.

listDeliveryLocationSets.description: Returns delivery location sets in a stable, cursor-paginated order.

listDeliveryMethods.description: Returns delivery methods in a stable, cursor-paginated order.

listDeliveryProfiles.description: Returns delivery profiles in a stable, cursor-paginated order.

listDeliveryQuotes.description: Returns persisted delivery quote diagnostics in stable creation order.

listDeliveryRateCallbacks.description: Returns delivery rate callbacks in a stable, cursor-paginated order.

listDeliveryZones.description: Returns delivery zones in a stable, cursor-paginated order.

listDeveloperPartnerAppInstalls.description: Returns installs for a partner app owned by the authenticated merchant.

listDeveloperPartnerApps.description: Returns partner apps owned by the authenticated merchant.

listDeveloperSandboxes.description: Returns the merchant's sandboxes, including archived sandboxes. Flint guarantees a default test sandbox for every merchant. Use an onboarding session token during setup or a normal external API key afterward.

listDevices.description: Returns a paginated list of devices for the authenticated merchant.

listDisputes.description: Returns a paginated list of disputes for the authenticated merchant with optional payment, customer, status, reason, case type, and timing filters.

listFeedbackReports.description: Lists feedback reports in descending creation order for the credential's merchant and environment.

listFraudWarnings.description: List early fraud warnings for the authenticated merchant environment.

listFulfillmentEvents.description: Lists provider-neutral fulfillment events. Results default to newest received first.

listFulfillmentNotifications.description: Returns persisted fulfillment notification audit records. Results default to newest created first.

listFulfillments.description: Returns fulfillments for operational queue and order-detail views. Results default to newest created first.

listGiftCardLoads.description: Lists funding lots in descending ID order. Consideration may be null for imported balances whose original purchase price is unknown. The idempotency_key filter recovers a load after a lost command response.

listGiftCardNotifications.description: Lists recipient notification identities, schedules and delivery outcomes. No redemption codes or recipient access tokens are returned.

listGiftCardRedemptions.description: Lists reservations and captured redemptions in descending ID order. Retrieve by idempotency_key to recover an operation after a lost response.

listGiftCards.description: Lists gift cards in descending ID order within the authenticated merchant and environment. Reads include masked codes, posted balance, reserved value and available value. Purchased cards have no expiry or service fees.

listGiftCardTransactions.description: Lists immutable financial entries across the merchant in ascending merchant_sequence order. Per-card sequences and balance snapshots support reconciliation. Reservations and code replacement never create financial debits.

listInventoryAllocationPolicies.description: List allocation policies. Archived policies are excluded unless you filter by status archived.

listInventoryItems.description: List inventory items. Archived items are excluded unless you filter by status archived.

listInventoryLevels.description: List inventory levels. Send expand=inventory_item to render each level's inventory item inline, so a stock table needs no read per row. Filter by inventory_item_status to see only the levels behind items that can be sold. Levels are strongly consistent individually, but pages may reflect different committed instants.

listInventoryMovements.description: List inventory movements, oldest recorded first. Send expand=inventory_item to render each movement's inventory item inline, so a history table needs no read per row. Filter by idempotency_key to recover the movements a command produced. Send order=desc to read the newest movements first.

listInventoryReceipts.description: List completed inventory receipt effects. Use typed Return filters for reconciliation when the receipt was created by Returns.

listInvoiceActivities.description: Returns a read-only history of an invoice for timelines and debugging, newest first. Use sort_direction=asc for chronological order. Read the invoice and the resources each row references for authoritative state.

listInvoiceDeliveryAttempts.description: Returns email delivery attempts for send and reminder actions.

listInvoicePaymentAttempts.description: Lists card and ACH collection attempts for an invoice in reverse chronological order.

listInvoicePaymentTerms.description: Returns a paginated list of invoice payment terms for the authenticated merchant.

listInvoices.description: Returns a paginated list of invoices for the authenticated merchant.

listLocations.description: List Locations. Filtering by inventory_allocation_status requires commerce.inventory.read; the inventory block is omitted entirely when the caller lacks inventory read authority.

listMeAddresses.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Lists the customer's saved addresses with billing and shipping default flags.

listMeCreditNotes.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns credit notes for the authenticated merchant, newest first. Filter by invoice_id to see everything credited against one invoice.

listMeDeletionRequests.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. Lists the current buyer's deletion requests in the selected merchant environment, newest first by requested_at.

listMeFlintWalletPaymentMethods.description: Returns the current buyer's usable wallet cards in newest-first order. Each id is an opaque per-store handle. store_payment_method_id is null until this store holds a copy. Requires a customer session minted from a live email-code buyer login at a Flint-hosted store account, including a login narrowed to a custom domain. Email links, checkout sessions, grants, merchant-created sessions, and API keys receive 404. Live and sandbox wallets are isolated. The full card collection is returned; has_more is false. Flint wallet support must be enabled.

listMeFulfillmentEvents.description: Lists fulfillment events for an order owned by the current buyer, ordered by occurred_at descending. Internal merchant fields are omitted. order_id is required.

listMeFulfillments.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns fulfillments for operational queue and order-detail views. Results default to newest created first.

listMeGiftCards.description: Requires a full customer session. Saved access requires possession of a current code or recipient link. Customer associations and purchase history do not authorize access. Replacing a code invalidates saved access; save again with fresh proof. Saved access does not permit spending or reveal a full code. Lists valid saved cards by saved time then card ID, descending.

listMeGiftCardTransactions.description: Requires a full customer session. Saved access requires possession of a current code or recipient link. Customer associations and purchase history do not authorize access. Replacing a code invalidates saved access; save again with fresh proof. Saved access does not permit spending or reveal a full code. Lists the full anonymous balance-change history by per-card sequence, descending. Other holders' identities and order references are omitted.

listMeInvoices.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns a paginated list of invoices for the authenticated merchant.

listMeOrderActivities.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns a read-only, human-readable history log for an order. Use it to render timelines and debug what happened, not as a source of truth, ledger, or webhook replacement. Read the owning resource for authoritative state: the order for balances and status, the payment for payment state, the refund for refund outcomes, and the checkout session for checkout state. Do not sum balance_delta_money to compute an order balance. Informational rows such as payment_failed, refund_failed, and checkout_session_expired have a zero balance delta. The default order is newest first. Use sort_direction=asc for chronological timeline rendering. A typical chronological log might show created, payment_failed, payment, refund, then refund_failed; each row gives one reference to click through for the authoritative resource.

listMeOrders.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns a paginated list of orders for the authenticated merchant.

listMePackages.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Lists package records, newest created first.

listMePaymentMethods.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns saved payment methods for the merchant, optionally filtered to a customer. By default, only active payment methods are returned. Filter by usage off_session to list the payment methods a subscription, automatic invoice, or default payment method can use.

listMePayments.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns a paginated list of payment intents for the authenticated merchant.

listMerchantBillingBalances.description: Returns what the merchant currently owes Flint and owns as account credit by currency.

listMerchantSubscriptionInvoices.description: Returns invoices issued by Flint for the authenticated merchant environment.

listMeRefunds.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns a paginated list of refunds for the authenticated merchant.

listMeReturns.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. List Returns for the merchant, filtered by order, customer, status, decision, merchandise, resolution, or creation window. Filter by idempotency_key to recover a create whose response never arrived.

listMeShipments.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Lists shipment execution records, newest created first.

listMeSubscriptions.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns a paginated list of subscriptions for the authenticated merchant. subscription_plan is always included without expand: the plan's current summary, or null when the subscription has no plan.

listOrderActivities.description: Returns a read-only, human-readable history log for an order. Use it to render timelines and debug what happened, not as a source of truth, ledger, or webhook replacement. Read the owning resource for authoritative state: the order for balances and status, the payment for payment state, the refund for refund outcomes, and the checkout session for checkout state. Do not sum balance_delta_money to compute an order balance. Informational rows such as payment_failed, refund_failed, and checkout_session_expired have a zero balance delta. The default order is newest first. Use sort_direction=asc for chronological timeline rendering. A typical chronological log might show created, payment_failed, payment, refund, then refund_failed; each row gives one reference to click through for the authoritative resource.

listOrderPaymentAttempts.description: Returns payment attempts for the order, newest first. Checkout-session callers see only attempts created by their own session.

listOrders.description: Returns a paginated list of orders for the authenticated merchant.

listOrganizationMemberships.description: Returns the direct memberships for an organization.

listOrganizations.description: Returns the organizations accessible to the caller, filtered to the authenticated merchant's organization subtree for external API keys.

listPackageItems.description: Lists order line quantities contained in packages.

listPackages.description: Lists package records, newest created first.

listPaymentIntents.description: Returns a paginated list of payment intents for the authenticated merchant.

listPaymentLinks.description: Returns a paginated list of payment links for the authenticated merchant.

listPaymentMethodDomains.description: Returns payment method domains ordered by payment_method_domain_id ascending in the selected Flint environment. Page tokens are opaque, bind to the list parameters, and return a validation error when invalid or mismatched.

listPaymentMethods.description: Returns saved payment methods for the merchant, optionally filtered to a customer. By default, only active payment methods are returned. Filter by usage off_session to list the payment methods a subscription, automatic invoice, or default payment method can use.

listPayoutDestinations.description: Returns a paginated list of payout destinations available to the authenticated merchant.

listPayoutEntries.description: Lists the authoritative balance-transaction allocations for a payout in ascending occurrence order. A paid payout returns an unavailable error instead of incomplete or inferred entries.

listPayouts.description: Returns a paginated list of payouts with optional filters for status, currency, destination, method, and timing.

listProducts.description: Returns a paginated list of products for the authenticated merchant.

listPromotionCodes.description: Returns a paginated list of promotion codes in every status, ordered by created_at descending, then promotion_code_id descending. Deleted codes are excluded.

listPromotions.description: Returns a paginated list of promotions for the authenticated merchant.

listRefunds.description: Returns a paginated list of refunds for the authenticated merchant.

listReports.description: Lists reports in descending creation order using opaque pagination.

listReturnDispositions.description: List merchandise dispositions. Omitting return_id lists dispositions across every Return for the merchant.

listReturnInspections.description: List inspection observations. Omitting return_id lists inspections across every Return for the merchant.

listReturnLineItems.description: List the line items on a Return with their quantity counters, eligibility, frozen display identity, and return value.

listReturnPolicies.description: List Return policies with their status and current revision.

listReturnPolicyRevisions.description: List every published revision of a Return policy.

listReturnReasons.description: List Return reasons, including Flint-provided defaults and merchant-defined reasons.

listReturnReceipts.description: List merchandise receipts. Omitting return_id lists receipts across every Return for the merchant.

listReturnResolutions.description: List resolutions. Filter by corrects_return_resolution_id to retrieve the correction history for a resolution that already settled.

listReturns.description: List Returns for the merchant, filtered by order, customer, status, decision, merchandise, resolution, or creation window. Filter by idempotency_key to recover a create whose response never arrived.

listReviews.description: List payment reviews for the authenticated merchant environment.

listRiskListItems.description: List risk list items for the authenticated merchant environment.

listRiskLists.description: List risk lists for the authenticated merchant environment.

listRiskRules.description: List risk rules for the authenticated merchant environment.

listShipments.description: Lists shipment execution records, newest created first.

listSubscriptionPaymentRetries.description: Returns a subscription's manual payment retries, newest first.

listSubscriptionPlans.description: Returns a paginated list of subscription plans for the authenticated merchant.

listSubscriptions.description: Returns a paginated list of subscriptions for the authenticated merchant.

listWebhookDeliveries.description: Returns endpoint deliveries created for one canonical webhook event.

listWebhookDeliveryAttempts.description: Returns the attempts recorded for a specific webhook delivery.

listWebhookEndpoints.description: Returns a page of webhook endpoints for the authenticated merchant.

listWebhookEvents.description: Returns recent canonical webhook events for the authenticated merchant.

listWebhookEventTypes.description: Returns the webhook event types that can be used in enabled_events and event_type filters, grouped by the event source each type is valid for.

lookupEmailPreferenceLink.description: Reads an emailed preference token without signing the buyer in. The merchant key must match the token's merchant and environment. Tokens belong in the request body and must stay on your backend.

lookupGiftCard.description: Evaluates a full bearer code in a request body. Codes contain 16 ASCII Crockford base32 characters, accept lowercase and hyphens, and normalize O to 0 and I/L to 1. Lookup is side-effect-free and never reserves funds. Unknown, other-merchant and unusable codes return the same error.

markInvoiceUncollectible.description: Closes the outstanding balance as a write-off and releases the order's invoice collection authority. Safe to retry with the same Idempotency-Key.

pauseMeSubscription.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Pauses a subscription immediately, optionally for a fixed number of billing cycles. A buyer's pause follows the store's customer_account.buyer_capabilities.

pauseSubscription.description: Pauses a subscription immediately, optionally for a fixed number of billing cycles. A buyer's pause follows the store's customer_account.buyer_capabilities.

payOrder.description: Starts or resumes a payment attempt on the order. Set action to pay to charge the full outstanding balance, confirm_payment_intents to confirm order-owned payment intents, setup to save a newly collected token on a zero-balance order, or resume to continue an attempt after a pending client action. Each action accepts only its own fields. Only confirm_payment_intents accepts completion_behavior. A pay action without payment_source is valid only when the outstanding balance is zero. To continue a resumable attempt, send action: resume with order_payment_attempt_id and a new Idempotency-Key. An exact retry of the original request with its Idempotency-Key returns the stored response if the request completed, or recovers the same attempt if it was interrupted. Payment intents with manual capture return an active authorization instead of settling immediately.

previewPartnerInstallAuthorization.description: Validates the install link inputs and returns the partner app metadata and requested permissions for the consent screen.

processExistingReturn.description: Record decisions, receipts, inspections, dispositions, and resolutions for an existing requested or open Return in one request. Refunds, payments, replacement orders, and inventory updates complete asynchronously. expected_version is optional and checked only when sent. If the Return has changed since that version, the request fails with RETURN_VERSION_CONFLICT. Requires Idempotency-Key and all three scopes: commerce.returns.write, commerce.returns.operations.write, and commerce.returns.resolutions.write.

publishLocationGeography.description: Publishes the location geography atomically. Supply the complete address and timezone; omitted coordinates are cleared. This PATCH does not merge nested address fields. Requires expected_geography_revision, independently of the location version used for metadata edits.

publishReturnPolicyRevision.description: Publish a new immutable Return policy revision while preserving the stable policy identity.

reactivateMeSubscription.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Clears a pending period-end cancellation without changing the current billing period.

reactivateSubscription.description: Clears a pending period-end cancellation without changing the current billing period.

recordManualInvoicePayment.description: Applies an offline/manual payment to an issued invoice. Recording is rejected with INVOICE_PAYMENT_RESOLVING while an online payment is still resolving; an idle open checkout does not block. A payment that clears the balance invalidates the open checkout session. Safe to retry with the same Idempotency-Key.

refreshCustomerSession.description: Rotates a customer session secret and refresh token without a merchant API key. Reusing a rotated refresh token revokes the session family.

refreshMerchantAccountSession.description: Creates a fresh provider session from a signed launch token after rechecking the authenticated principal, merchant environment, account controller, and component grant. An onboarding session can refresh only sandbox launch tokens created by the same user with an onboarding session. The sandbox is pinned by the launch token, using the merchant's default sandbox unless sandbox_id named another sandbox of the same merchant at creation. Live onboarding requires a live API key, and refresh requires the same API key that created the launch token.

regenerateInvoicePublicLink.description: Revokes the current buyer-access link and all checkout credentials derived from it, then returns a new public_url. The current checkout session and its payment lineage are preserved. Safe to retry with the same Idempotency-Key.

releaseInventoryReservation.description: Release held or committed quantity back to available. Cumulative targets; released quantity is terminal.

releaseReturnResolution.description: Release a confirmed resolution that is waiting on a manual release. Available only while action_reason is manual_release.

removeMeGiftCard.description: Requires a full customer session. Saved access requires possession of a current code or recipient link. Customer associations and purchase history do not authorize access. Replacing a code invalidates saved access; save again with fresh proof. Saved access does not permit spending or reveal a full code. Removes only this buyer's saved access without changing funds or other holders' access. Repeated removals succeed.

removeMePaymentMethod.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Soft-removes a saved payment method so it can no longer be used for future payments.

removeOrderDiscounts.description: Removes one or more pending applied discounts from an order. Redeemed or canceled discounts are settlement history and cannot be removed.

removeOrderGiftCard.description: Removes a selected gift card without moving value. The order revision must still match. Selections cannot change during an active payment attempt.

removePaymentMethod.description: Soft-removes a saved payment method so it can no longer be used for future payments.

reopenReturn.description: Reopen a completed Return to record late compensating facts. Confirmed money movements are never edited backward, so a monetary fix is a new correction resolution.

repriceOrderDiscounts.description: Recalculates pending discounts and automatic promotions for a mutable order.

resendWebhookDelivery.description: Sends the canonical event payload again to the delivery's current webhook endpoint URL. Safe to retry with the same Idempotency-Key.

resetDemoSession.description: Ends the caller's current demo sandbox (if any) and provisions a fresh one, returning a new temporary API key. Useful when the original one-time secret was lost. Subject to the same per-client email failure limit as creation.

resetDeveloperSandbox.description: Clears a non-default sandbox and returns its replacement environment. The replacement has a new sandbox ID, retains the stable provider-account lineage, and requires newly issued test keys.

resolveCustomerDeletionRequest.description: Approves or rejects a pending deletion request. Approval returns processing while account data and buyer credentials are deleted asynchronously. A failed deletion can be approved again but cannot be rejected. Approval is blocked while the customer has non-canceled subscriptions or usable saved payment methods.

resolveOrderInventoryException.description: Marks a paid inventory failure as resolved after an operator has completed manual inventory remediation.

resolvePaymentLink.description: Creates a buyer checkout session from an active payment link. Catalog-backed modifier availability is frozen onto the checkout session and selected modifiers are resolved onto the backing order.

resumeMeSubscription.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Requests resumption of a paused subscription. Processing is asynchronous, so the response can still show paused. Retrieve the subscription to follow its status. Paid access resumes only when the subscription is active; overdue payment must be collected first.

resumeSubscription.description: Requests resumption of a paused subscription. Processing is asynchronous, so the response can still show paused. Retrieve the subscription to follow its status. Paid access resumes only when the subscription is active; overdue payment must be collected first.

retryReturnDisposition.description: Retry a failed disposition with the same immutable intent. Disposition and effect identities are preserved, so a retry does not move stock twice.

retryReturnResolution.description: Retry a failed resolution. A new attempt starts, historical payment and refund IDs stay on the resolution, and a late event from an earlier attempt cannot settle the new attempt.

reverseCreditNoteAllocation.description: Reverses an allocation and reopens that much of the invoice balance. The original allocation keeps its row and gains reversed_at, so the history stays append-only. Reversing the allocation that closed an invoice moves it from credited back to open or partially_paid.

reverseManualInvoicePayment.description: Reverses previously applied manual/offline payment amount from an invoice. Safe to retry with the same Idempotency-Key.

revokeAPIKey.description: Permanently revokes an external API key and returns metadata with status revoked.

revokeCustomerSession.description: Revokes one customer session. This does not revoke an independent Flint Account buyer session.

revokeCustomerSessions.description: Revokes every customer session for one customer in the selected merchant environment. Flint Account buyer sessions remain independent.

revokeDeliveryDependency.description: Permanently fences one exact method, endpoint, signing key, revision, or Location geography version. Issued quotes are revoked immediately. Current selections are released the next time they are read. Stable method and callback-endpoint targets require expected_version so a concurrent publication cannot broaden the revocation.

revokeDeveloperPartnerAppInstall.description: Revokes a partner app install and all of its environment grants.

revokeDeveloperPartnerEnvironmentGrant.description: Revokes a single test or live environment grant for a partner app install.

revokeOrganizationMembership.description: Revokes a direct organization membership for a user.

rotateDeliveryRateCallbackSigningKey.description: Rotates the endpoint signing secret, accepts both keys for one hour, and returns the new secret once.

rotateDeveloperPartnerAppSecret.description: Rotates the client secret for a partner app owned by the authenticated merchant. The new client_secret is only returned once.

rotateGiftCardCode.description: Invalidates the old bearer credential and generates a new code for the same gift card. Balances, funding, reservations and refund history are preserved. Requires commerce.gift_cards.secrets.write. Include notification to send the new private recipient link. Retired links cannot open the current code.

rotateWebhookSecret.description: Rotates the signing secret for a webhook endpoint and returns the new secret once.

saveMeGiftCard.description: Requires a full customer session. Saved access requires possession of a current code or recipient link. Customer associations and purchase history do not authorize access. Replacing a code invalidates saved access; save again with fresh proof. Saved access does not permit spending or reveal a full code.

saveMePaymentMethod.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Initiates saving a payment method and returns the client setup payload needed to complete setup on the frontend.

savePaymentMethod.description: Initiates saving a payment method and returns the client setup payload needed to complete setup on the frontend.

sendInvoiceReminder.description: Attempts a reminder email for an already issued collectible invoice. Safe to retry with the same Idempotency-Key.

sendMeOrderReceipt.description: Queues a receipt email for one of your paid orders to the order's email. Requires Flint-managed receipt delivery. Sending is limited to once every five minutes per order and recipient.

sendOrderReceipt.description: Queues a receipt for a paid order, including gift card payments and settled payments. Send email to choose a recipient, or omit it to use the order's email. Requires Flint-managed receipt delivery. Sending is limited to once every five minutes per order and recipient.

setDefaultCustomerAddress.description: Sets the address as the billing default, shipping default, or both and makes it the customer's effective address for each selected role.

setDefaultMeAddress.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Sets the address as the billing default, shipping default, or both and makes it the customer's effective address for each selected role.

setDefaultMePaymentMethod.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Sets the default payment method for the payment method's owning customer. Subscriptions and automatic invoices charge the default without the buyer, so the payment method's usage must be off_session.

setDefaultPaymentMethod.description: Sets the default payment method for the payment method's owning customer. Subscriptions and automatic invoices charge the default without the buyer, so the payment method's usage must be off_session.

skipSubscriptionCycle.description: Moves the next billing date forward by one plan interval without charging the current cycle.

startOnboarding.description: Starts the consolidated onboarding flow by emailing a short-lived verification code and returning a temporary verification token.

streamWebhookEvents.description: Streams canonical merchant webhook events created after the connection opens or after the supplied event ID. SSE event IDs are resumable webhook event IDs. Control records include ready, gap, withheld, and disconnect. Gap and withheld records advance the resumable cursor even when a resource payload is expired or hidden by API-key scope.

transferOrganizationOwnership.description: Transfers the organization owner role to another user.

transitionFulfillment.description: Performs one action from the fulfillment's supported_actions. Each action accepts only its action-specific fields. expected_version is optional and rejects a stale resource version when supplied.

transitionGiftCard.description: Freezes spending, removes a merchant freeze, or closes a card after all value and restrictions are resolved. Unfreezing cannot remove unresolved funding-dispute restrictions. Freezing does not release accepted payment reservations.

transitionInventoryTransfer.description: Run one action from supported_actions using cumulative line targets. Send expected_version to reject the request if the transfer changed after you read it. The response includes the updated transfer and its inventory effects.

transitionPackage.description: Performs one action from the package's supported_actions. expected_version is optional and rejects a stale resource version when supplied.

unsubscribeEmailPreferenceLink.description: Disables the email preference represented by an emailed token without signing the buyer in. Repeating the request keeps it disabled. The merchant key must match the token's merchant and environment.

updateAPIKey.description: Updates an active external API key's name or complete scope list. API-key-authenticated callers may delegate only scopes already granted to the calling key.

updateCheckoutSession.description: Updates the mutable fields of a checkout session. A merchant credential can update metadata and external_reference_id, including after the session ends. The session's own checkout credential can send buyer_contact and timezone while the session is open. The buyer_contact field saves the email and phone the buyer entered; send a contact field as null to clear it. The timezone field records the buyer's IANA time zone, which Flint uses for times in the emails it sends the buyer. Saving the same values again changes nothing.

updateCreditNote.description: Updates draft credit note fields and corrections atomically. Omitted fields are unchanged, a null memo clears it, and credit_note_lines requires expected_version. Issued and void credit notes are frozen.

updateCustomer.description: Applies a sparse update to a customer. Writing billing_address or shipping_address clears the corresponding saved-address default, so that field remains effective until another saved default is selected.

updateCustomerAddress.description: Applies a sparse update to a saved address. Updating a default address also updates the customer's effective address for that role.

updateDeliveryLocationSet.description: Sparsely updates mutable fields. A change to pinned configuration publishes a new immutable revision and requires expected_version.

updateDeliveryMethod.description: Sparsely updates mutable fields. A change to pinned configuration publishes a new immutable revision and requires expected_version.

updateDeliveryProfile.description: Sparsely updates mutable fields. A change to pinned configuration publishes a new immutable revision and requires expected_version.

updateDeliveryRateCallback.description: Sparsely updates mutable fields. A change to pinned configuration publishes a new immutable revision and requires expected_version.

updateDeliveryZone.description: Sparsely updates mutable fields. A change to pinned configuration publishes a new immutable revision and requires expected_version.

updateDeveloperPartnerApp.description: Updates the API version for a partner app owned by the authenticated merchant. Any supported version can be selected.

updateDevice.description: Applies a sparse update to a device. Send location_id=null to unassign a location.

updateFulfillment.description: Updates mutable fulfillment fields and fulfillment-specific details. Fulfillment line item allocation is set when the fulfillment is created. expected_version is optional and rejects a stale resource version when supplied.

updateGiftCard.description: Updates descriptive associations. Omitted fields are preserved; null clears external_reference_id or customer_id. This operation cannot change balances, currency, code or status.

updateInventoryAllocationPolicy.description: Update policy fields, availability, or atomically replace its routing configuration. Send expected_version to reject concurrent changes.

updateInventoryCount.description: Replace a count's observations atomically. Send expected_version to reject concurrent changes.

updateInventoryItem.description: Update an inventory item. Accepts status active or inactive. Send sku or barcode as null to clear.

updateInventoryLevel.description: Set one inventory level's safety_stock_quantity. Returns the updated level with durable command evidence.

updateInventoryTransfer.description: Update an open transfer's planning details.

updateInvoice.description: Updates mutable fields on a draft invoice. After issue, the only writable field is reminders_paused, which pauses or resumes automatic reminders on an open or partially paid invoice.

updateInvoicePaymentTerm.description: Update invoice payment term for the authenticated merchant.

updateLocation.description: Update a Location's profile or availability. Accepts status active or inactive.

updateLocationInventory.description: Enable or disable inventory allocation at a Location. Omit expected_inventory_revision when enabling inventory for the first time; otherwise send the current inventory_revision.

updateMe.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. Updates the current buyer's name or phone. Manage billing and shipping addresses through /v1/me/addresses.

updateMeAddress.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Applies a sparse update to a saved address. Updating a default address also updates the customer's effective address for that role.

updateMeEmailPreferences.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. Turns the optional email categories in the body on or off for the customer's current email at this merchant in the selected merchant environment, and leaves the others as they are. The setting follows the email address, so it also covers guest checkouts with the same email. A customer without an email has no email preferences, and the change answers 404 with CUSTOMER_EMAIL_REQUIRED.

updateMerchant.description: Applies a sparse update to the authenticated merchant's public business profile fields.

updateOrder.description: Applies a sparse update to mutable order fields such as customer_id, notes, metadata, tax, the delivery destination, and the requested tip. Send requested_tip: null to clear the current requested tip.

updateOrderCharge.description: Updates a single service charge, fee, or surcharge on an order.

updateOrderLineItem.description: Updates a single line item on an order. Send gift_card_recipient and expected_version to replace or clear recipient delivery details before any purchase funding. Checkout credentials can update recipient details or modifiers, each with expected_version.

updateOrganization.description: Applies a sparse update to an accessible organization.

updatePackage.description: Updates non-lifecycle package fields such as carrier, tracking, label access, measurements, metadata, and caller-owned external references. Package status cannot be patched directly. expected_version is optional and rejects a stale resource version when supplied.

updatePackageItem.description: Updates a package item quantity or metadata while the package is still mutable.

updatePaymentIntent.description: Applies a sparse update to a payment intent before it reaches a terminal state.

updatePaymentLink.description: Updates a payment link. To replace line items, custom fields, or delivery methods, send the complete array with `expected_version`.

updatePaymentMethodDomain.description: Sets the domain registration status. Activating the domain also validates Apple Pay and Google Pay readiness.

updatePayoutDestination.description: Updates mutable metadata and settings for a payout destination. Safe to retry with the same Idempotency-Key.

updatePayoutSettings.description: Updates mutable payout settings for the authenticated merchant. Safe to retry with the same Idempotency-Key.

updateProduct.description: Applies a sparse update to product-parent fields. When categories is present, it replaces the full category list; send an empty array to clear categories. Sellable price, SKU, and inventory live on variants.

updatePromotion.description: Applies a sparse update to promotion fields.

updatePromotionCode.description: Applies a sparse update to a promotion code.

updateReturn.description: Update caller-owned fields on a Return. Only external_reference_id and metadata are writable; every other change goes through a decision, operation, or resolution command.

updateReturnLineItem.description: Update a requested Return line item. Send null to clear buyer_note or requested_resolution_type. The response is the updated Return.

updateReturnPolicy.description: Update policy identity fields or set status to active or inactive. Rules live on revisions, so changing a window, fee, or scope means publishing a new revision.

updateReturnReason.description: Update a Return reason. Send null to clear description. A present category_handles array replaces the existing set.

updateReturnResolution.description: Update a proposed resolution before confirmation. A present line_items or replacement_line_items array replaces that collection and requires expected_version.

updateRiskList.description: Update a risk list for the authenticated merchant environment.

updateRiskRule.description: Update a risk rule for the authenticated merchant environment.

updateSettings.description: Applies a sparse patch to merchant-scoped settings. Send catalog by itself because it has its own version fence. Fee and payment limit controls remain internal-only.

updateShipment.description: Updates shipment metadata and caller-owned external references. Shipment status is derived from package statuses and cannot be patched directly. expected_version is optional and rejects a stale resource version when supplied.

updateSubscription.description: Updates subscription metadata and external_reference_id. Change the payment method with the payment-method route and undo a scheduled cancellation with the reactivate route.

updateSubscriptionBillingSchedule.description: Sets the next billing date, clears an external schedule while it awaits a date, or transfers schedule ownership. The response carries the updated subscription.

updateSubscriptionPlan.description: Applies a sparse update to mutable subscription plan fields. Line items are mutated through the subscription plan line-item endpoints.

updateWebhookEndpoint.description: Updates the mutable fields on a webhook endpoint.

validateCustomDomain.description: Rechecks ownership and restarts validation for the configured checkout or customer account hostname. Send no request body or an empty JSON object. Each domain can be checked once every 60 seconds; rate limited responses include Retry-After.

verifyOnboardingEmail.description: Verifies the emailed code, provisions the Flint user and merchant if needed, and returns an onboarding session token. The token expires at onboarding_session_expires_at and cannot be refreshed. Verify the email again to get a new one.

verifyReturnReceiptLineItem.description: Establish the Return line identity for receipt quantity that arrived without one. Unverified quantity counts toward no line and releases no refund timing gate until it is verified.

voidCreditNote.description: Voids an issued credit note. Every allocation has to be reversed first. Void is terminal, and an invoice cannot be voided while an issued credit note stands against it.

voidInvoice.description: Voids an unpaid invoice so the associated order can be edited or collected again. An invoice with an issued credit note against it cannot be voided until that credit note is voided.

voidPackage.description: Voids a package before carrier handoff and appends a package timeline event. Voided package items no longer count against fulfillment package allocation capacity. expected_version is optional and rejects a stale resource version when supplied.

voidShipment.description: Voids a shipment before carrier handoff and voids all child packages that have not shipped. The action appends timeline events for the shipment and affected packages. expected_version is optional and rejects a stale resource version when supplied.

waiveInvoiceLateFee.description: Waives the unpaid remainder of an assessed late fee. Collected money is not refunded. The reason is visible only to the merchant.

waiveReturnLineInspection.description: Waive the inspection requirement on a Return line item so received quantity can be dispositioned and resolved without an inspection observation.
